name: Clip Clip
tagline: Picks the few stream or podcast moments worth posting and cuts them
description: Sits over a finished podcast or livestream recording as a gatekeeper rather than a grinder. Each night it looks for passages strong enough to stop a scroll, cuts only those into captioned sixty-to-ninety second excerpts, and stays quiet when nothing clears that bar, so anything it hands over is already shortlisted.
author: prcshxnt
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
